page_title: BAR 3-0 MAL | Barcelona v Mallorca 07/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
86' It's a nice effort by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Joan Garcia. Easy save.
84' The game has come to an end for Fermín. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Tomas Marques (Barcelona).
83' 3 - 0 Marc Bernal (Barcelona) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Leo Roman with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:0.
81' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
81' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Joan Garcia is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
80' Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) commits a rough challenge and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle for a foul.
78' Robert Lewandowski will be replaced by Joao Cancelo (Barcelona).
78' Here is a change. Lamine Yamal is going off and Hansi Flick gives the last tactical orders to Roony Bardghji (Barcelona).
77' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Vedat Muriqi and he is replaced by Javier Llabres (Mallorca).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) will replace Samu Costa.
75' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) makes space inside the box for a shot, but his effort goes just wide of the left post.
70' The attendance is 44301.
69' A quickly taken corner by Barcelona.
67' It is time for a substitution. Marc Bernal (Barcelona) is on for Dani Olmo.
67' Hansi Flick has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ferran Torres (Barcelona) replacing Marcus Rashford.
67' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) brings his opponent down. Alejandro Quintero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Barcelona.
62' A substitution has been made. Mateu Morey Bauza is replaced by Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca).
62' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Pablo Torre will be replaced by Sergi Darder (Mallorca).
62' It's time for a substitution. Mateo Joseph (Mallorca) comes on in place of Jan Virgili.
61' 2 - 0 Goal! Dani Olmo plays a long ball to Lamine Yamal (Barcelona), who cuts inside and unleashes a screamer into the right of the goal. The keeper had no chance. Superb strike! 2:0.
61' The ball goes out for a corner. Barcelona can continue in their attacking effort.
61' The corner kick from Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
59' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post.
59' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
59' Marc Casado (Barcelona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
58' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
58' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Leo Roman stops the ball from going inside the left post.
57' Marc Casado (Barcelona) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar.
55' Barcelona failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
55' Barcelona work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

53' Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Alejandro Quintero with no other option than to blow for a foul.
50' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
50' Pablo Torre (Mallorca) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul.
48' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) sends a direct shot in from the free kick that's in a promising position. The ball sails to the top right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a quick save to deny him.
45+3' Alejandro Quintero blows for a foul after Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
40' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) picks up an injury.
39' The game is interrupted as Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca) is flagged offside.
37' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
36' The corner is swung in but Barcelona can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
36' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
29' 1 - 0 Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) connects with a pass inside the box and slams home into the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
27' A clumsy foul by Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) and Alejandro Quintero blows his whistle.
26' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the right post!
24' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mallorca comes to nothing.
22' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Joan Garcia makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
18' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
17' What a huge chance for Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
12' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the bottom left corner is denied by a decent save from Joan Garcia.
11' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
11' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
8' Barcelona have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
8' Marcus Rashford (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
6' Jan Virgili (Mallorca) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
5' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Alejandro Quintero saw the whole situation.
3' The resulting set piece from Barcelona is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
1' The linesman signals that Jan Virgili (Mallorca) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
1' The first half has started.
